errors.evidence: The description states the large jump in the purple line ("Mindestlohn") occurs at the beginning of 2023. The chart shows this jump happens before the 'Jan. 2023' tick mark, in late 2022 (specifically, it coincides with the rebasing of other indices in October/Q4 2022).

The description of the light green line ("HVPI (Index, 2015 = 100)") states it starts 'just under or around 100'. The legend specifies the index starts at 100 for 2015, and the line on the chart visually starts exactly at the 100 mark, not below it.

errors.evidence: The description of the light green line ("HVPI (Index, 2015 = 100)") claims it reaches the 140s range in 2022. The chart shows this line ending around Jan. 2023 at a value of approximately 125. It never reaches the 140s; the value of 141.2 belongs to the start of the rebased dark green line.

errors.evidence: The description states the light blue line ("Bruttostundenlöhne und -gehälter") reaches 'the area of 130' by the end of 2022. The line actually ends around a value of 127, making '130' a slight overestimation.
